sources.title: Takes of Marine Mammals Incidental to ONR Arctic Research Activities, Beaufort and Chukchi Seas (Year 9). Proposed incidental harassment authorization, 91 FR 46055-46079, published 2026-07-22, docket RTID 0648-XF841. Comments close 2026-08-21 and the notice also requests comment on a possible one-year renewal. THIS IS THE ONLY PRIMARY SOURCE FOR THE FILM.

Full raw text of the same notice. Every string the film puts inside quotation marks was certified character by character against this, after the first pass was caught carrying one fabricated quote and two misquotes.

Per-figure attribution. The 900 Hz navigation sources, the up-to-six mooring ceiling, trilateration with dead reckoning as the fallback, Level B harassment only, no serious injury or mortality expected, prior-IHA compliance, the Beaufort beluga estimate of 39,258 dated 1992, and the Arctic ringed seal stock being ESA threatened with abundance undetermined all come from the notice above. R/V Sikuliaq being NSF-owned and UAF-operated does NOT: the notice names no operator, and that fact is sourced to UAF's own College of Fisheries and Ocean Sciences site plus secondary reference, because the primary vessel page returned 503 during the run.
